name: kit-ride
about: LumaKit ride (lumakit.md 2.21, lumakit-modules.md row 11). kit-ride on EggStarGalaxy. mount: the data mount board (kit/ride/board.json) made on the player is ridden; a code mount's on_mount runs once. ride_planet: the stick held ahead 90 frames moves the mount more than 600 units, on the ground. jump: A held 2 frames raises it more than 50 along its up. mounted_move: the mount's move (kit.player.state, Start.Code) enters while mounted and is refused when not. thrown_off: an enemy attack on the rider ends the ride, on_dismount once. dismount: ride.dismount() ends a ride, on_dismount again. mod_off: the mod taken out while riding (the rider let off, its mounts killed). WAITING: classes.alias, MR::getPlacementArg0NoInit's mark, LUMA_ marks on MR::setBaseTRMtx's MtxPtr and the MtxPtr result of MR::getJointMtx as mat34, the factory facts of SimpleMapObj (F); std make/MakePlace, model/model_named, mat34(r0, r1, r2), mods.kit_read/kit_names/needing (K); player.state allow (the moves gate); the mod's Board model with a Seat joint (assets).
